english translation text: O MOTHER I AM ON A SPEAR

arabic text: RONE LAGE KEHNE LAGE TAB ALI ASGHAR\nNAIZE SE ASGHAR KO NAZAR AAYI JO MAADAR\nDEKHA KHULA SAR HAI PARESHAN HAI MUZTAR
english translation text: WHEN ALI ASGHER ( WITH HIS HEAD ON THE SPEAR) SAW HIS MOTHER\nHE SAW HIS MOTHER ANXIOUS AND WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: MAA MUJHE APNE SEENE SE LAGALE\nMAA MUJHE APNI GODI ME CHUPALE\nMAA MAI NAIZE PE HOO
english translation text: O MOTHER, HUG ME TO YOUR CHEST,\nO MOTHER, HIDE ME IN YOUR LAP,\nO MOTHER, I AM ON A SPEAR

arabic text: AMMA BAHUT DIN HUVE JHOOLE MAY NA SOYA\nMAA TERI IZZAT KI KASAM PHIR BHI NA ROYA
english translation text: OH MOTHER, IT HAS BEEN MANY DAYS I HAVE NOT SLEPT IN MY CRADLE,\nOH MOTHER, I SWEAR BY YOUR HONOUR, I DID NOT CRY,

arabic text: AB TUJHE DEKHA TO MERE LAB HUVE GOYA\nAAJ BANDHE HAATHON KO JHOOLA SA BANALE\nSEENE SE LAGAALE, MAA ME NAIZE PE HOO
english translation text: NOW WHEN I HAVE SEEN YOU, MY LIPS HAVE STARTED MOVING,\nTODAY CAN YOU PLEASE MAKE A CRADLE WITH YOUR TIED HANDS,\nHUG ME TO YOUR CHEST, O MOTHER I AM ON A SPEAR.

arabic text: JISM KAHAN SAR HAI KAHAN HAAYE MUKADDAR\nAMMA BADAN REHGAYA KARBAL KI ZAMEEN PAR
english translation text: MY BODY IN ONE PLACE AND MY HEAD IN ANOTHER, OH MY FATE,\nOH MOTHER, MY BODY WAS LEFT ON THE PLAINS OF KARBALA,

arabic text: AMMA TERE SAATH CHALA AAYA MERA SAR\nKARTA TUJHE KAISE LAYEENO KE HAWALE\nSEENE SE LAGAALE, MAA ME NAIZE PE HOO
english translation text: AND MY HEAD HAS COME ALONG WITH YOU, O MOTHER,\nHOW COULD I LEAVE YOU WITH THOSE CURSED PEOPLE.\nHUG ME TO YOUR CHEST, O MOTHER I AM ON A SPEAR.

arabic text: GARM HAWA GARM ZAMEEN JALTA HUWA TEER\nAMMA ZARA SOCHO MERE KHAD SE BADA TEER
english translation text: THE HOT AIR, THE HOT EARTH & THE BURNING ARROW,\nOH MOTHER, JUST IMAGINE THE ARROW WAS TALLER THAN ME,

arabic text: KAISE KAHUN HALQ PE JIS WAQT LAGA TEER\nHOGAYE BEHOSH MUJHE DEKHNE WALE\nSEENE SE LAGAALE, MAA ME NAIZE PE HOO
english translation text: HOW SHALL I DESCRIBE THE PAIN THAT I ENDURED WHEN THE ARROW HIT ME,\nTHE ONLOOKERS FAINTED WHEN THEY SAW ME\nHUG ME TO YOUR CHEST, O MOTHER I AM ON A SPEAR

arabic text: KABSE SAKINA NE NAHI MUJHKO KIYA PYAR\nKARBOBALA KUFA KAHAN SHAAM KA BAZAAR
english translation text: SAKINA HAS NOT HUGGED ME FOR A LONG TIME,\nSINCE KARBALA, KUFA AND THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM,

arabic text: DARTI HAI KYA KHOON SE BHARE DEKH KE RUKSAAR\nNAIZE KE NAZDEEK ZARA USKO BULAALE\nSEENE SE LAGAALE, MAA ME NAIZE PE HOO
english translation text: IS SHE AFRAID OF SEEING MY BLOOD-STAINED CHEEKS?\nPLEASE BRING HER CLOSER TO THE SPEAR MY HEAD IS ON\nHUG ME TO YOUR CHEST, O MOTHER I AM ON A SPEAR

arabic text: DHOOP MAY TUNE NA KABHI GHAR SE NIKAALA\nAMMA BADE PYAR SE TUNE MUJHE PAALA
english translation text: YOU NEVER TOOK ME OUT OF THE HOUSE WHEN THE SUN WAS BLAZING,\nOH MOTHER, YOU LOOKED AFTER ME WITH SO MUCH LOVE AND CARE,

arabic text: AAJ NAHI KOI MUJHE DEKHNE WAALA\nTUHI MUJHE DHOOP KI SHIDDAT SE BACHAALE\nSEENE SE LAGAALE, MAA ME NAIZE PE HOO
english translation text: AND TODAY THERE IS NO ONE TO LOOK AFTER ME,\nOH MOTHER, PLEASE SAVE ME FROM THIS BURNING SUN\nHUG ME TO YOUR CHEST, O MOTHER I AM ON A SPEAR
